cards.definition: A short party game for about 2–8 players. Everyone runs a shop or a job, borrows, gives gifts, and elects a governor. There is no turn order.

zh-Hans.definition: 短局聚会，大约 2 到 8 人。大家同时经营商店或职业、借钱、送礼、选州长。没有回合排队。

cards.definition: Each player secretly locks in what they will do. When time is up, the host resolves every order together.

zh-Hans.definition: 每人秘密写下这个月要做的事。到点后，房主把所有订单一起结算。

cards.definition: The host’s phone runs the rules. The relay only passes messages; it does not decide the game.

zh-Hans.definition: 规则在房主的手机上跑。中继只负责转发消息，不替你们做决定。

cards.definition: When the game ends, the highest monthly cash flow ranks first. Interest on cash counts.

zh-Hans.definition: 游戏结束时，月现金流最高的人排第一。现金的存款利息也算进去。

cards.definition: Cash on hand earns about 0.5% to 0.7% each month.

zh-Hans.definition: 手里的现金每月大约有 0.5% 到 0.7% 的利息。

cards.definition: Each life has a private goal. Finish it and the bonus is paid at once.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个人有自己的目标。做完会立刻发奖金，不用等到结束。

cards.definition: Draw 3 and keep 1. It is a shop owner or an office worker, and it sets your starting cash, upkeep, and tags.

zh-Hans.definition: 每人抽 3 张，选 1 张。要么是店主，要么是白领，上面写着起始现金、负担和标签。

cards.definition: The living cost printed on your life card. It is paid in the month-end settlement.

zh-Hans.definition: 人生卡上写的生活成本。每个月末结算时要付。

cards.definition: Income, tax, maintenance, interest, and living costs are all applied together at the end of the month.

zh-Hans.definition: 月底把收入、税、维护费、利息和生活成本一起算清楚。

cards.definition: Spend it on land, a down payment, living costs, or a gift.

zh-Hans.definition: 用来买地、付首付、过日子，也可以送礼。

cards.definition: Spend it to use a credit card, break an election tie, or cast a diplomatic vote.

zh-Hans.definition: 用来刷信用卡、在选举打平时破平，也可以投外交票。

cards.definition: How many things you can do this month, including upgrades. Also called actions.

zh-Hans.definition: 这个月能做几件事，升级也要花它。也叫经营点。

cards.definition: Tap a part of town to see its tax rate, who lives there, and the contacts you can meet.

zh-Hans.definition: 点开一块城区，能看到当地税率、人群和能结识的人脉。

cards.definition: The colored blocks you own: shops and other businesses on the map.

zh-Hans.definition: 地图上你的彩色方块，就是你的店和其他生意。

cards.definition: Parks, cafés, and arcades. Visit them to meet people and gain influence.

zh-Hans.definition: 公园、咖啡馆、街机厅能结识人脉，并增加影响力。

cards.definition: Shops earn from four crowds: youth, adults, the elderly, and tourists. Tax and policy change that income.

zh-Hans.definition: 商店向四类人赚钱：青年、成人、老年、游客。税和政策会改收入和维护费。

cards.definition: Buy a home or a shop with a down payment, about 20% by default. The town board sets the interest.

zh-Hans.definition: 买房或买店可以不付全款。首付默认大约 20%，利息由城镇板决定。

cards.definition: The whole table elects one player. You may vote to recall instead of choosing a person.

zh-Hans.definition: 全体一起选一名州长。也可以不选人，改投罢免。

cards.definition: A vote to remove the current governor instead of electing someone.

zh-Hans.definition: 选举时可以投罢免，把现任州长换掉，而不是选一个新人。

cards.definition: The governor appoints one. It cannot be the governor, and it cannot be last term’s director.

zh-Hans.definition: 州长任命一名总监。不能是州长自己，也不能是上一任总监。

cards.definition: The director looks at 3 in private and passes 2. Policies help some people and hurt others, so the table has to bargain.

zh-Hans.definition: 总监私下看 3 张政策，传出 2 张。政策有利有弊，总会有人吃亏，所以要谈判。

cards.definition: While passing policies, the director may inspect one player.

zh-Hans.definition: 总监传政策时，可以审计一名玩家，看他的情况。

cards.definition: The governor keeps 1 of the 2 policies and discards the other. The signed policy starts next month.

zh-Hans.definition: 州长在传来的 2 张里签署 1 张，另一张丢掉。签下的政策下个月生效。

cards.definition: One political step per month, in order: elect, appoint, pass, sign. Shops do not pause for it.

zh-Hans.definition: 政治每月只走一步：选举、任命、传政策、签署。店铺不会为此停下来。

cards.definition: The first months have no offices, so the table can learn. Then elections start. A cabinet lasts about 16 months.

zh-Hans.definition: 前几个月没有官职，先练手，然后再选举。内阁任期较长，默认大约 16 个月。

cards.definition: For 5 or more players. Tags are public; the secret identity is honest, corrupt, or an outside puppet.

zh-Hans.definition: 建议 5 人以上。标签公开，身份秘密：廉洁、腐败，或外来傀儡。

cards.definition: Five honest policies pay the honest side, and living costs are cut in half.

zh-Hans.definition: 签下 5 张廉洁政策后，廉洁方兑现，生活费减半。

cards.definition: Five corrupt policies pay the corrupt side and the puppet a large bonus. Three are enough if a puppet is governor.

zh-Hans.definition: 5 张腐败政策让腐败方和傀儡各得一大笔奖金。傀儡当州长时，3 张就够。

cards.definition: A secret identity. If this player is governor, the corrupt side only needs 3 policies.

zh-Hans.definition: 一种秘密身份。傀儡当州长时，腐败方只要 3 张政策就能兑现。

cards.definition: From the politics page, give cash or an industry at once. The other player cannot refuse.

zh-Hans.definition: 在政治页可以把现金或产业立刻送给别人。对方不能拒绝。

cards.definition: A score from 0 to 100 between two players. Gifts, and helping a bot’s request, raise it.

zh-Hans.definition: 两人之间 0 到 100 的关系。送得多，或帮机器人完成请求，羁绊会升高。

cards.definition: A promise spoken at the table is not enforced. Scripted bot schemes, such as a pyramid or a wager, can pay or break on their own.

zh-Hans.definition: 嘴上说好的交易，游戏不管。机器人的套路，比如传销或赌约，会按脚本兑现或食言。

cards.definition: Short side games: basketball is first to 5 or 40 seconds, boxing is 2 rounds of 20 seconds, poker is 2 hands.

zh-Hans.definition: 篮球先到 5 分或 40 秒；拳击 2 回合、每回合 20 秒；扑克打 2 手。

cards.definition: Build the best city. Characters are called in order, then you gather, use an ability, and build.

zh-Hans.definition: 比谁的城市更好。角色按号码传召，轮到你就收集资源、用能力，然后建造。

cards.definition: A building in your city. One city cannot hold two identical districts.

zh-Hans.definition: 你城里的一栋建筑。同一座城市不能有两个相同的区域。

cards.definition: The usual goal is 7 districts, or 8 with 2–3 players. When someone reaches it, that round is the last.

zh-Hans.definition: 通常建满 7 个区域就结束，2 到 3 人时是 8 个。有人建满后，这一轮打完游戏就结束。

cards.definition: Characters are called from number 0 up to 13. You act only when one of yours is called.

zh-Hans.definition: 角色按号码从 0 叫到 13。叫到你的角色，才轮到你行动。

cards.definition: Take 2 coins, or draw 2 cards and keep 1. Then use the character’s ability, then build.

zh-Hans.definition: 先拿 2 金币，或抽 2 张留 1 张。再用能力，最后建造。

cards.definition: The crown picks characters first. In an auction, the crown wins a tie.

zh-Hans.definition: 持有王冠的人先选角色。暗拍打平时，王冠优先。

cards.definition: Bid coins on a character in secret. The highest bid wins and only the winner pays. Unspent bid coins go to your treasure.

zh-Hans.definition: 用金币秘密出价抢角色。最高的得到，只有赢家付钱。没用完的金币进宝库。

cards.definition: If you win no character, you take a leftover one, or a Citizen.

zh-Hans.definition: 这一轮没拍到角色，就拿剩下的角色，或者当平民。

cards.definition: Districts are Noble, Religious, Trade, Military, or Unique. A city with all five scores 3 extra points.

zh-Hans.definition: 区域分贵族、宗教、贸易、军事、独特。五种都有，额外加 3 分。

cards.definition: Add up district values, +3 for all five types, +4 for finishing first (+2 for anyone else who also finished), plus Unique bonuses.

zh-Hans.definition: 把区域价值加起来。五种齐全加 3，最先建满加 4，其他建满的人加 2，再加上独特区域的奖励。

cards.definition: Character colors rank Stone, then Bronze, then Silver, then Gold. A command needs a character of that tier or higher.

zh-Hans.definition: 角色颜色从低到高是石、铜、银、金。敕令要用同阶或更高的角色来发起。

cards.definition: Every 4 rounds the Sultan deals a secret task. Finish it with a character of that tier or higher for 4, 8, 12, or 16 coins. You may redraw once per game. A broken command never returns.

zh-Hans.definition: 苏丹每 4 轮发一张秘密任务。用同阶或更高的角色完成，奖励 4、8、12 或 16 金币。每局可以换牌一次。已打破的敕令不会回到牌堆。

cards.definition: The co-op mode. Break every command together within 4 rounds each. Miss one and everyone loses. Empty the deck and you win. The top scorer is the MVP.

zh-Hans.definition: 合作模式。大家一起打破所有敕令，每张限 4 轮。任何一张超时，全员失败。敕令池清空就赢。得分最高的是最佳玩家。

cards.definition: In a competitive game, miss your command’s deadline and you are out of the city.

zh-Hans.definition: 竞技局里，敕令超时你就被处决，离开这座城。

cards.definition: Two revealed characters each roll a die plus Charisma. If yours is higher, they become a couple and must be picked together from then on.

zh-Hans.definition: 两个已亮出的角色各掷骰加魅力。你更高，他们就在一起，以后必须一起被选。

cards.definition: Attack a district. Both sides roll: your die plus Combat against their die plus Combat plus the district’s value.

zh-Hans.definition: 进攻别人的一个区域。你掷骰加战斗力，对方掷骰加战斗力再加区域价值。

cards.definition: Before the turns, challenge a player. Bet 1–5 coins, pick champions, and roll die plus Combat. The loser’s character is executed.

zh-Hans.definition: 回合开始前挑战一名玩家。下注 1 到 5 金币，各选冠军，掷骰加战斗力。输的那个角色被处决。

cards.definition: Put up to 2 coins into a district to raise its value. Each of your turns, you earn coins equal to what you have invested.

zh-Hans.definition: 往一个区域里最多投入 2 金币，提高它的价值。之后每个回合，你拿回已投资的金币数。

cards.definition: Hold an unpicked character for next round so it joins your hand for free.

zh-Hans.definition: 指定一个还没被选的角色，下一轮免费进你的手牌。

cards.definition: The good majority. Their abilities help the town. Good wins when every Demon is dead.

zh-Hans.definition: 善良阵营的大多数，能力是来帮忙的。所有恶魔死亡时，善良获胜。

cards.definition: A good character whose ability can hurt their own team.

zh-Hans.definition: 也是善良的，但能力可能会拖累自己人。

cards.definition: Evil. They know the Demon and help by lying. They do not kill at night.

zh-Hans.definition: 邪恶阵营。他们认识恶魔，主要靠说谎帮忙，夜里不杀人。

cards.definition: Evil, and they kill at night. Evil players know each other. Evil wins when only 2 players are alive, or when several Demons make evil half of the living players.

zh-Hans.definition: 邪恶，夜里杀人。邪恶玩家互相认识。只剩 2 名存活玩家时邪恶获胜；多个恶魔时，邪恶达到存活人数一半也获胜。

cards.definition: Put one living player up for execution. Each living player may nominate once a day, and each player may be nominated only once.

zh-Hans.definition: 提议今天处决某一名存活玩家。每人每天只能提名一次，每人也只能被提名一次。

cards.definition: Everyone votes on a phone. The nominee with the most votes dies if the votes reach half the living players. A tie executes nobody.

zh-Hans.definition: 大家在手机上投票。票最多、并且至少达到存活人数一半的人被处决。平票则谁都不死。

cards.definition: The ability does not work, and the player is not told. Their information may be wrong.

zh-Hans.definition: 能力失效，但本人不知道。得到的信息可能是错的。中毒也是这样。

cards.definition: A dead player keeps one vote for a later execution. They may still talk, but they cannot nominate.

zh-Hans.definition: 死亡玩家之后还有一张票，留到重要的处决再用。他们仍能说话，但不能提名。

cards.definition: How a character looks to someone else’s ability. The Recluse may look evil. The Spy may look good.

zh-Hans.definition: 别人的能力看到你时，你可能不像真实身份。陌客可能显示为邪恶，间谍可能显示为善良。

cards.definition: Guess a number, then bet coins on which guess will win. The most coins at the end wins.

zh-Hans.definition: 先猜一个数，再把硬币押在你看好的猜测上。最后硬币最多的人赢。

cards.definition: The winning guess is the highest number on the board that is still at or under the real answer. If every guess is over, “smaller than all” wins.

zh-Hans.definition: 获胜的是板上不超过正确答案的最大那个数。如果每个猜测都超了，“比所有都小”获胜。

cards.definition: Guesses near the middle of the line pay 2 to 1. Guesses toward either end pay more, up to 5 to 1.

zh-Hans.definition: 数字排在中间的猜测赔 2 倍。越靠两端赔得越多，最高 5 倍。

cards.definition: Every player has one coin that is never spent. On the winning guess it pays the odds and comes back. Bank coins on a wrong guess are lost.

zh-Hans.definition: 每人有一枚不会花掉的硬币。押中就按赔率赚钱，并且这枚硬币还在。普通硬币押错就没了。

cards.definition: A question with fixed choices and no number to guess. Put one coin on the answer you think is right.

zh-Hans.definition: 这种题不用猜数字。把一枚硬币押在你认为对的选项上。
